capabilities.target: libc tcgetattr, setsid, close_range, open, getdents64 and fcntl in the forked child before exec; getrlimit in the parent
capabilities.justification: Refuses a terminal on the agent's standard descriptors, leaves the supervisor's session, and makes every inherited descriptor above 2 close-on-exec between fork and exec (D18S S-I2, S-I3); std's Command offers no portable way to do any of these.

capabilities.target: libc fcntl(F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC), dup2, _exit and the raw execveat syscall (Linux), for isolate_and_exec
capabilities.justification: Places exactly the broker's key descriptors at 3..3+n and executes the verified descriptor itself (D18S S-K1, S-I3); std cannot exec a descriptor.

capabilities.target: the broker binary named by configuration
capabilities.justification: VerifiedExecutable hashes the binary through its own descriptor before every launch, so what runs is what was pinned.

capabilities.target: the digest-verified broker binary, by descriptor
capabilities.justification: isolate_and_exec runs execveat on the verified descriptor; no path is ever executed.

justification: Spawn-time descriptor isolation for D18 agent processes. The one unsafe pre_exec hook lives here so the supervisor crates can keep forbid(unsafe_code).
